## Topic selection

The selected question is **Can an eBPF Attachment Follow a Recreated Workload?**

Linux BPF links attach programs to concrete kernel targets. Kubernetes replacement can preserve
a logical workload role while creating a new Pod UID and new Linux target objects. The report
separates logical workload identity, orchestrator generation, and kernel target generation,
then develops target-generation receipts, two-generation reconciliation, and a replacement
coverage-witness benchmark.

Primary evidence: Linux eBPF syscall documentation, current Linux cgroup/BPF lifecycle source,
libbpf attachment/pinning interfaces, and current Kubernetes Pod lifecycle documentation.
